cim: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber will first launch to a limited number of customers in its Daybreak Red program and has found 81+ "novel" vulnerabilities in Firefox (Djohnson/CyberScoop)

prioritas.cim_hu: A Firefoxban talált sebezhetőségekkel mutatkozott be az OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber modellje
